title: It was AMAZING!
text:
Yesterday, I took part in a four-course cooking class at the Paella Club, and I had such a wonderful time! Our instructor, Valencia, her assistant, and the rest of the group made the experience so much fun. Music played throughout the class, so we danced, enjoyed some wine, and cooked together in a lively, welcoming atmosphere.

Once the cooking was done, we all sat down to enjoy the meal and share stories about where we came from and how we were enjoying our time in Barcelona. It was such a lovely way to connect with people from different places while sharing delicious food and great company.
author: CoachLinda321

title: So easy to learn....I left feeling competent to make paella on my own!
text: Great fun, delicious food, great chef and assistants!  I enjoyed the hands on experience, the info shared.  Everything was well organized, set a steady pace and easy to understand!  Wine and music - superb!  I cannot wait to make paella at home for family and friends!
author: F8644LPmargaretl

title: So personalized and felt luxurious at every step
text: Hands down the most fun our team has had at a cooking class, and several of us have done a few. It's not just ‘watch and learn’  you're dancing, eating, drinking, and cooking all at once. We walked away actually knowing how to make paella, but honestly the vibe alone was worth it. If you want a team activity people are still talking about weeks later, this is it.
author: amirae871

title: Fun but not so much food
text: What a nice experience! We went as 2 couples and e had a great time. Our host did a very good job of keeping the whole activity interactive and fun. Wine was flowing the whole time. What would say— we left hungry! There was a seafood paella that was made with 4 shrimp for 6 people … a veggie and a chicken. When it came down to eating, we devoured each of them and got tapas on our way home. Overall experience was great though.
author: Tiffany_C

title: Fun and low stress plan for an evening in Barcet
text: It was a fun evening with knowledgable guidance. We learned, enjoyed the people and drank a fair amount too. Fun evening.
author: DawnC450

title: A fun and memorable evening!
text: We learned some great tips for making paella, and  also enjoyed sampling all of the varieties. Our host, Kevin, was energetic and made the experience very fun. Highly recommend.
author: Joseph K

title: Paella Club
text: This experience was a Christmas gift from our children. Wonderful! A+. My husband has always wanted to make paella the correct way. This class did not disappoint. The cooking stations were spacious, the kitchen was beautiful and inviting. Most of all, the paella was absolutely delicious. Great step by step guidance by our professional chef. The music was flowing and the Cava was flowing!
author: benayj

title: This cooking class was so...
text: This cooking class was so much fun. The staff are excellent and the food was delicious. Everyone got to try multiple dishes at the end during a large group sit down dinner
author: Jennifer_M

title: So much fun
text: We had such a fun time. What a great activity!  Highly recommend planning to participate. Great food, Cava, wine and chefs leading the instruction.
author: Californiatraveler56

title: Join the Paella Club! It’s fun and tasty!
text: The host was charming and energetic! The staff very friendly and accommodating. A great time was had by all that participated in this cooking class. Everything was well organized, ingredients prepared and fun atmosphere! There was a bit of dancing involved if you chose to participate but not required. I would definitely take friends back and highly recommend this as a nite on the town.
author: Rickilene E
